This suggests the white collar/shirt area around the neck may have a structural anomaly resembling a medical device, which aligns with the 'fusion' artifact noted by the Router but adds a semantic layer of error. The severity of the subject's structural defects is high enough to warrant a low artifact score, despite the background being relatively clean.
